cases.name: form-8974-post-2022-two-quarters
cases.description: A $500,000 post-2022 election applied over two quarters: each quarter offsets its employer social security liability first (the election's first $250,000 is social-security-only) and Medicare next, carrying $463,000 then $414,000 forward; $86,000 applied in total.
cases.source: IRC § 41(h) and the Instructions for Form 8974 (https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i8974, verified 2026-10-01), via rule card us-fed.rd-payroll-offset; arithmetic hand-derived in lib/openstartup/__tests__/rdCredit.test.ts

cases.name: form-8974-pre-2023-social-security-only
cases.description: A pre-2023 $250,000 election is social-security-only: the quarter's $50,000 social security liability is offset and its $20,000 Medicare liability goes untouched.
cases.source: IRC § 41(h) and the Instructions for Form 8974 (https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i8974, verified 2026-10-01), via rule card us-fed.rd-payroll-offset
